description: Operator uploaded a new build: attach latest, build_number (ASC build version), or build_id to the current store version; optionally submit for review when confirm_submit_for_review=true.

attach_only.description: true = attach only, do not submit

confirm_submit_for_review.description: true = after attach, create review submission and PATCH submitted=true

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

name: submit_build_for_review
